title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Apricity
description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the audit of Apricity (develop), one checklist line each.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] https://apricity.anth.us/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and /favicon.ico return 404; add them.
- [ ] play.apricity.anth.us has no DNS (NXDOMAIN) but is referenced in the auth redirect-urls.ts:6; Apricity-web references are tracked on its own cleanup card.
- [ ] README lists stale tabs, crates and features; bring them in line with the code.
- [ ] README.md:8 says "Phase 5 in progress", which is stale.
- [ ] Ticket IDs in comments under analysis/apricity_analyze/*.py, and a "supervisor acceptance" handoff message at semantic_evaluation.py:192; remove the internal wording.
- [ ] Branch codex/semantic-audio-checkpoint has a committed target-music/ build tree and .DS_Store; delete the branch (Ryan's call, deletion is not done by the audit).

**How to verify**
Each box is checked by the curl or grep named in it; for example `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://apricity.anth.us/robots.txt` returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
